_comment: Street look (Roadmap 2, Session 1): lamps, benches, dustbins, transformers, construction sites, footbridges and extra street trees. Sizes in metres. Placed by src/world/street/plan.js with its own seeded random numbers, so the rest of the city (buildings, signs, trees) stays exactly the same. 'chance' = 0..1. Lamp/prop models come from assets/street/street-props.glb (Kenney City Kit Roads, CC0); benches, bins, transformers, bamboo scaffolding and footbridges are built in code (src/world/street/meshes.js).

lamps._comment: Street lamps along every block edge. slot = where in each gap between two electric poles (0 = at one pole, 1 = at the next). fromKerb = distance from the road edge. Lamps face the road. parkSpacing = grid of double lamps in parks (0 = none).

night._comment: How lamps look at night. bulb = colour of the glowing bulb; bulbDay = its colour by day (off); bulbBoost = how bright (above 1 = blooms). pool = colour of the light pool on the ground; poolRadius = its size; poolStrength = how bright (0-1); poolSoftness = [distance from the centre 0-1, brightness 0-1] steps of the soft circle. Both fade in with the lit windows (data/dayNight.json → keys.windows). Load-shedding switches them off in the dark district.

realLights._comment: A few REAL lights (they light up cars, people and walls) at the street lamps nearest to the player, only at night. How many depends on the quality (data/quality.json → streetLights; 0 on Low). intensity/distance/decay = three.js point light settings. updateSeconds = how often the nearest lamps are picked again.

benches._comment: Benches on the inner side of the sidewalk, facing the road, and in parks. slot = position between poles (like lamps). binChance = a dustbin next to the bench. parkChance = per park lamp, a bench next to it.

bins._comment: Small dustbins at the kerb on their own (as well as next to benches). colors = bin colours, picked at random.

dumpsters._comment: Big green city waste containers in the small lanes inside blocks. chance = per lane.

transformers._comment: Pole-mounted power transformers (two poles, a platform and a grey transformer box). chance = per electric pole. platformY = platform height. gap = distance between the two poles.

trees._comment: Extra street trees in the gaps where there was none yet. slot = position between poles. minGap = never closer than this to another tree.

construction._comment: Construction sites: a building wrapped in BAMBOO scaffolding (very Dhaka), sometimes with a green net, a fence on the sidewalk and cones and barriers at the kerb. chance = per city block (one site at most). minFloors = only buildings this tall. bay = scaffold cell size. offset = distance from the wall. netChance = share of sites with a net (netOpacity: 0 = invisible, 1 = solid). fenceFromKerb = where the site fence stands. cones = how many cones along the kerb.

footbridges._comment: Steel foot overbridges across main roads (not under the MRT / flyover, not next to landmarks or bus stops). chance = per road between two city blocks. minGap = at least this many blocks between two bridges on the same road line. clearance = height under the deck (buses fit). The stairs run along the kerb on both sides. Lamps on the deck light up at night.
